title: Fish and Chips
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into thick chips, rinse them in cold water, then dry them completely with a clean tea towel.

Toss the chips with a good splash of olive oil, the sweet paprika and a pinch of salt. Spread them in a single layer, cut side down, on an unlined baking tray and bake for 45 minutes, turning once halfway, until golden and crisp.
While the chips bake, set up three shallow dishes: the plain flour seasoned with salt and pepper in the first, the eggs whisked in the second, and the panko breadcrumbs in the third.
Pat the fish fillets dry with paper towel and cut into 8 even pieces. Coat each piece in flour, dip in the egg, then press firmly into the panko so the crumbs stick all over.
When the chips have about 15 minutes to go, heat a generous layer of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat until it shimmers.
Fry the fish in two batches so the pan stays hot, 3-4 minutes each side, until the crumb is deep golden and the fish flakes easily. Drain on paper towel and season with salt while hot.
Pile the fish and chips onto plates and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce.
